item.title: LP gains more control of Abia House of Assembly as PDP’s Adiele defects

item.title: Lack of transparency in election bane of Nigeria’s democracy – Don
item.description: A Professor of Communications at Baze University, Abiodun Adeniyi, has suggested why Nigeria’s elections are always shrouded in dispute.
